name: Attachments — wage determination, reps and certs, security
notes: The content that lives past the base document and used to be invisible: attachments were stored and filtered out of every run. Short, dense, and heavy on certifications and clause references — the categories most likely to carry a disqualification.

certification.quote: must certify that it is not debarred
certifies that it has an active registration in SAM.gov
This certification is a material representation of fact

obligation.quote: The Contractor shall pay not less than the prevailing wage rates
The Contractor shall submit certified payrolls
The Contractor is required to post the wage determination
The Offeror shall complete the representations and certifications
The Offeror must certify that it is not debarred
The Offeror shall represent whether it is a small business
Personnel shall hold a Secret Facility Clearance
The Contractor may not subcontract any portion of this work
Incidents shall be reported within 72 hours
